title: Bounded ordinary decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let each vertex be assigned a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^q$ taking values in $[-1,1]$, and let $\\varepsilon\\in\\mathbb R$ and a default symbol in $\\mathrm{Fin}(q)$ be given. The bounded ordinary decoding value is the candidate-decoding value computed from the candidates produced by this table and $\\varepsilon$, using the specified default symbol.
